title: Default Mirror Activation shortcut conflicts with non-US keyboard layouts
author: lennartb-
summary: ZoomIt registers a generated Ctrl+Alt+9 DemoMirror window shortcut from its Ctrl+9 default; Windows delivers German and Danish AltGr+9 as that chord, so the system-wide registration consumes the closing-bracket keystroke.

status.label: Fix design ready
status.detail: A reproducible, source-cited report establishes the registration-level collision. Open issue #37143 covers the same broader ZoomIt AltGr behavior, but no upstream fix PR exists.

next_action.label: Review the companion-hotkey design
next_action.reason: Choose and validate a non-AltGr-consuming way to retain the derived window actions before implementation.

judgment.rationale: The 2026-09-03 discussion supplies a reproducible CI result and matches the current source: ZoomIt derives and registers a Ctrl+Alt companion from the default Ctrl+9 Mirror shortcut. That registration, not a character comparison or a handler-side decision, consumes AltGr+9 before ZoomIt can distinguish it. Related open issue #37143 confirms this is a broader Record/DemoMirror class, but it is not an existing implementation and the linked mangokingTW/PowerToys PR is explicitly a draft reproduction, not a merge candidate.
evidence: The original German report and a Danish confirmation both show AltGr+9 being consumed by DemoMirror; changing the DemoMirror base shortcut moves the collision to the corresponding AltGr chord.

The latest commenter reproduced the failure on stock hosted x64 and Arm runners with German layout, including a physical VK_RMENU AltGr injection; AltGr+9 did not type ], while an adjacent AltGr+8 control typed [.
src/modules/ZoomIt/ZoomIt/Zoomit.cpp derives mirrorWindowMod as g_MirrorToggleMod ^ MOD_ALT and registers MIRROR_WINDOW_HOTKEY with it; the default g_MirrorToggleKey is Ctrl+9 in ZoomItSettings.h.
The same file derives and registers the Record window companion from g_RecordToggleMod ^ MOD_ALT, so a DemoMirror-only change would leave the demonstrated class of collision in Record.
The issue's diagnostic ZIP was inspected: its ZoomIt logs only record initialization and settings reloads, so they neither add a competing cause nor identify a different failing path.

Open issue #37143 has the same Product-ZoomIt scope and related AltGr reports. Draft PR https://github.com/mangokingTW/PowerToys/pull/5 contains CI reproduction tests only and states it is not for merge.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve a focused design that removes or replaces unsafe generated Ctrl+Alt companion registrations across Mirror and Record, then validate all registration, options-validation, settings-display, and reload paths with an AltGr regression scenario.

fix_assessment.rationale: No concrete upstream or fork implementation fixes the registration path. The only linked PR is a draft, explicitly non-merge reproduction suite; #37143 is an open related issue, not a fix.

proposed_fixes.title: Stop derived ZoomIt window hotkeys from claiming AltGr chords
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Observed source behavior: ZoomIt derives window-mode shortcuts by toggling MOD_ALT on the configured base hotkey and passes them to RegisterHotKey. With the default Ctrl+9 Mirror hotkey, that creates a Ctrl+Alt+9 registration. Windows delivers AltGr keyboard input through the Ctrl+Alt modifier form, and the global registration consumes the character before ZoomIt's WM_HOTKEY handler runs.
plan: Define the supported replacement behavior for the generated window-mode actions before code changes: the design must not register a Ctrl+Alt companion that aliases AltGr, and must preserve or intentionally replace access to Record and DemoMirror window capture.

Centralize the decision for generated companion shortcuts in src/modules/ZoomIt/ZoomIt/Zoomit.cpp so RegisterAllHotkeys, the options-dialog collision validation, initial startup registration, and settings-reload registration all apply the identical safe set for Record and Mirror.

Update src/settings-ui/Settings.UI/ViewModels/ZoomItViewModel.cs and src/settings-ui/Settings.UI/SettingsXAML/Views/ZoomItPage.xaml if the selected behavior changes which derived window shortcut is available or displayed; do not continue displaying a shortcut that is deliberately no longer registered.

Add a focused ZoomIt regression scenario based on the linked draft reproduction: with German layout and ZoomIt armed, AltGr+9 must type ] and must not show the mirror dialog. Cover the chosen replacement activation for window mirroring and the equivalent Record companion path.
verification: On a German layout with the default DemoMirror configuration, type AltGr+9 in a text editor and verify that ] is inserted and no ZoomIt window-mirror action or dialog appears.
Repeat the Danish AltGr+9 and changed-base-shortcut cases reported in the issue to confirm the fix is not limited to the digit 9 or one layout.
Exercise full-screen, region, and window Mirror modes plus full-screen, region, and window Record modes using the approved post-design activation model.
Re-run the issue-linked x64 and Arm64 reproduction controls: the neighboring AltGr+8 control still types [, and a known ZoomIt hotkey proves the module is armed.

confidence.rationale: The latest issue comment reproduces the effect across architectures and physical AltGr delivery, and the cited current registration code directly creates the conflicting Ctrl+Alt chord. The remaining product decision is how to retain window-mode activation without that registration.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys 0.101.2362 users on German and Danish layouts cannot type a closing bracket with AltGr+9 while ZoomIt DemoMirror is enabled because its generated window-mode shortcut takes the same system-wide chord.
known_information: The issue is open, labeled Issue-Bug, Needs-Triage, and Product-ZoomIt, with no assignee or linked upstream fix PR.
The reporter uses PowerToys 0.101.2362 installed through WinGet and reports German AltGr+9 should type ].
A Danish user reproduced AltGr+9 and showed that changing DemoMirror from Ctrl+9 to Ctrl+0 makes AltGr+0 collide instead.
The latest discussion reproduces the loss of ] in CI on stock hosted x64 and Arm64 runners and records the resulting ZoomIt dialog.
The attached diagnostic archive contains only ZoomIt initialization and settings-reload entries, not a hotkey failure trace.
Issue #37143 is an open ZoomIt AltGr tracker with related French and German reports; its discussion cross-references this issue.
inferences: Because the collision follows the configured base key and the source derives the Alt companion, changing the default number alone would not eliminate the class of issue.
A WM_HOTKEY handler check for right Alt would not restore a character already consumed by RegisterHotKey; the registration strategy must change.
issue_context.analysis: The fresh report moves this beyond duplicate triage. The failure is tied to a current, concrete RegisterHotKey call and independently reproducible behavior, while the related tracker establishes that the Record companion uses the same pattern. A code fix is appropriate, but its user-facing window-mode replacement must be deliberately designed rather than silently removing functionality.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue body and all four comments, current labels, empty assignee list, cross-references, and linked draft reproduction PR.
Inspected the issue ZIP and its ZoomIt and ModuleInterface logs; they contain initialization/enabling/reload records only.
Read the current Zoomit.cpp registration, options validation, startup, reload, and WM_HOTKEY handling paths.
Read the current ZoomIt settings defaults and Settings UI derived-shortcut display code.
Reviewed the DemoMirror introduction commit d2c53bf38 ([ZoomIt] Add DemoMirror feature, #49607), which documents Ctrl+9, Ctrl+Shift+9, and Ctrl+Alt+9 as the three generated modes.

information_gaps.information: The intended supported activation model for Record and DemoMirror window modes after unsafe Ctrl+Alt companions are removed or changed.
information_gaps.why_needed: The observed defect establishes what must not be registered, but product behavior must decide whether window mode becomes independently configurable or uses another non-conflicting invocation.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Confirm the desired UX in the fix-design review, then exercise all three capture modes on an international keyboard layout.

reproduce.title: Verify DemoMirror does not consume German AltGr+9
reproduce.version_requirement: PowerToys 0.101.2362 or a build containing the proposed fix
prerequisites: Windows with the German keyboard layout enabled
ZoomIt enabled and its first-run options dialog dismissed
DemoMirror configured with its default Ctrl+9 base shortcut
setup: Open a text editor and place the caret in an empty document.
Keep a single-monitor setup if available so the current defect produces the Screen mirroring requires a second monitor dialog.
steps: Press a known ZoomIt shortcut such as Ctrl+1 to confirm ZoomIt hotkeys are armed, then close the overlay.
Press AltGr+8 as a neighboring control and verify that [ is inserted.
Press AltGr+9 in the text editor.
reproduce.expected_result: Before the fix, ] is consumed and DemoMirror activates or displays its mirror dialog. After the fix, ] is inserted, no ZoomIt action occurs, and the approved window-mirroring activation remains available.
